what: Photo slides are swapped in WebGL. On open, wait .5s, then a capsule (463:320 superellipse) grows from the center to cover the screen over 1s expo.inOut. From its 1/4 point the first photo is warped like a lens (strength 6 → 0, 1.6s quint.out), held pulled in at .5x, then released over 1.5s quart.out. Every 4 seconds the next photo comes in overlapping for 1.2s sine.inOut with the same warp (1.6s quint.out) and pull (1.5s cubic.out). During each photo’s 5.2s stay it moves closer by 20% (4% on phone), and by a further 40% with the scroll passing through the designated section.
ease: expo.inOut (capsule) · quint.out (bend) · cubic.out / quart.out (pull) · sine.inOut (overlap) · none (hold zoom)

options.scroll: CSS for the section that measures scroll zoom (0 when the top touches the screen top → 1 when the bottom passes)
options.mask: If none, goes straight in without the capsule opening
options.mask-warp-at: Initial bend start (capsule length multiples), default .25
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: A single photo — inner Fill it by covering, and if absent draw a placeholder board from the inner .wf-img color and data-label
options.Event fx:mask-distort-slides: detail.index from the element — each time it moves on to the next photo
